# Frame Design System

> An open React design system and component library for AI products.

The exported React component collection is open-source and MIT licensed. People and AI can read, reuse, verify, and evolve Frame's design language together. Frame pairs AI-readable implementation guidance with automated design checks for machine-checkable rules to help generated interfaces stay aligned with the system. Passing these checks does not guarantee full compliance; human review remains necessary.

## Catalog

- [Live component catalog](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#buttons)
- [AI interaction patterns](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#ai-patterns)
- [Design principles](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#principles)

## Components

- [ChatMessage](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/chat-message.tsx): User and assistant message presentation with a visual streaming state. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/chat-message.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#chat-message).
- [ChatPanel](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/chat-panel.tsx): Conversation layout with message and composer slots and near-bottom scrolling. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/chat-panel.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#chat-panel).
- [ChatInput](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/chat-input.tsx): Prompt composer with callback-based sending, optional attachments and mentions. No model provider is included. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/chat-input.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#chat-input).
- [MessageCard](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/message-card.tsx): Inline event notice with information, success or warning tone and an optional action slot. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/message-card.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#message-card).
- [StatusTag](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/status-tag.tsx): Semantic status pill for pending, processing, review and completed states. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/status-tag.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#status-tag).
- [Tag](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/tag.tsx): Compact neutral label with an optional outline and tooltip. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/tag.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#tag).
- [SidePanelBody](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/side-panel-body.tsx): Scrollable conversation inspector body with spacing and an automatic scrollbar. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/side-panel-body.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#side-panel-body).
- [SectionCount](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/section-count.tsx): Compact count label for grouped messages, references or workflow steps. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/section-count.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#section-count).
- [TimePill](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/time-pill.tsx): Compact time or effort label using the shared status presentation. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/time-pill.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#time-pill).
- [StepIndicator](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/step-indicator.tsx): Visual pending, active and completed workflow step marker; pair with a text label. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/step-indicator.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#step-indicator).
- [SecondaryButton](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/secondary-button.tsx): Secondary action button for prompt or workflow decisions. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/secondary-button.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#secondary-button).
- [TertiaryButton](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/tertiary-button.tsx): Outlined action button for quieter conversation and workflow actions. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/tertiary-button.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#tertiary-button).
- [GhostPillButton](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/ghost-pill-button.tsx): Pill-shaped secondary action with optional icon and disabled state. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/ghost-pill-button.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#ghost-pill-button).
- [HeaderIconButton](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/header-icon-button.tsx): Named icon action for conversation headers; size the mobile hit area to at least 44 pixels. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/header-icon-button.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#header-icon-button).
- [MenuRow](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/menu-row.tsx): Workflow or conversation selection row with optional secondary text and current state. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/menu-row.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#menu-row).
- [IconBadge](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/icon-badge.tsx): Decorative icon badge for message context or workflow groups; not an interactive control. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/icon-badge.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#icon-badge).
- [TextButton](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/text-button.tsx): Quiet text action with disabled and disclosure attributes. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/text-button.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#text-button).
- [UtilityChip](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/utility-chip.tsx): Compact context action with optional pressed state for prompt toolbars. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/utility-chip.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#utility-chip).
- [SummaryFooter](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/summary-footer.tsx): Compact elapsed-time or summary line beneath a conversation result. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/summary-footer.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#summary-footer).
- [ChoiceCard](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/choice-card.tsx): Selectable title and description card for choosing a prompt or workflow option. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/choice-card.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#choice-card).
- [ReviewItemCard](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/review-item-card.tsx): Presentational review-result row with type, time and completed state; does not implement a review workflow. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/review-item-card.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#review-item-card).
- [EmptyState](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/empty-state.tsx): Icon and explanation for an empty message, result or reference area. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/empty-state.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#empty-state).
- [VersionRow](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/components/version-row.tsx): Version comparison and update-status presentation without a network or update client. [Example](https://github.com/BeibeiZhang/frame-design-system/blob/main/examples/version-row.tsx). [Viewer](https://system.beibeidesign.com/#version-row).

Citation and tool transparency are design guidance, not installable components in this collection.
